name: SubLingo
description: Translate nearby external SRT/ASS cues into an IINA second subtitle track.

permissionDescriptions.network-request: Connect to the bundled loopback helper, which contacts only the translation service you select.
permissionDescriptions.file-system: Read the selected external subtitle, store optional provider keys in a plugin-private local file, and maintain the temporary translated track.
permissionDescriptions.show-alert: Confirm permanent deletion of a translation profile and its saved credential.
